fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-02-12 at approximately 00:40, it was reported that unknown persons entered the property of the complainant near Amudham Layout Residential Colony without permission and refused to leave. The online submission was made by Madhan Nathan (9000000337). Jagan Velan (9000000339), described as a person who arranged the contact, was also mentioned in the complaint. Tamilarasan Muthu (mobile 9000000260) was named as a possible person of interest. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. A van bearing the number TN-33-XX-1030 was seen leaving the area. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00301, as the mobile number 9000000260 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Unauthorised entry reportedly noticed after the premises were locked.
